summary: Streaming chat responses cut off early (no [DONE] event); client reports SSE disconnect
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports streamed chat completions stop mid-response. Client sees SSE connection close and never receives the final '[DONE]' marker; partial assistant output is shown to end-users.

Impact:
Intermittent. Customer estimated ~5-10% of streaming calls during peak hours affected. Retries typically succeed but user-visible truncation is unacceptable.

Environment:
Dedicated cluster (heliotrope-prod) in us-east; OpenAI-compatible endpoint /v1/chat/completions with stream=true.

Steps to reproduce (from customer):
1) Send long prompts with tools enabled
2) Observe long pauses between deltas
3) Some calls end with connection closed before completion

What we saw internally:
Traces show long gaps (20-40s) between streamed deltas on tool-selection paths; api-gateway idle timeout closes downstream stream when no bytes flush for 30s.
comments: Hannah Schmitt (Support): Escalating per Heliotrope. Their wording: 'the stream just dies' / 'we don't get DONE'. They provided HAR + request IDs.
Ethan Park (Eng - runtime): Confirmed in tracing: long pause before next token chunk, then envoy closes downstream due to idle_timeout=30s. Upstream continues but client never sees it.
Ava Chen (Eng - platform): api-gateway config: stream idle timeout set to 30s. We usually rely on frequent deltas, but tool path has gaps. Option: send heartbeat comment frames or lower buffering.
Ethan Park: Implemented periodic keep-alive bytes on streaming responses when no token deltas emitted for 10s (runtime -> gateway). PRs linked in incident thread.
Hannah Schmitt: Customer confirmed improvement after rollout to heliotrope-prod; monitoring for 48h.
Resolution: Rolled out keep-alive flush for streaming responses + updated gateway docs/workarounds. Closing as resolved.
